subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers is NOT a tributary of the Ganga but flows directly into the Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Mahanadi River** originates from the Sihawa hills in Chhattisgarh and flows through Odisha before emptying directly into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Unlike rivers such as the Ghaghara, Kosi, and Gomti, which are tributaries of the Ganga, the Mahanadi is an independent river system.
 
• The Mahanadi is one of the major rivers of peninsular India, with a total length of approximately 858 kilometers.
 
• Its basin covers parts of Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh, making it a significant river for these regions.
 
• Important cities located along the Mahanadi include Sambalpur and Cuttack, with the Hirakud Dam being a notable landmark.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tributaries of the Ganga:**

 
 
• The Ganga River has several tributaries, including the Ghaghara, Kosi, Gomti, Yamuna, Gandak, and Son.
 
• These tributaries contribute significantly to the Ganga's flow and its extensive drainage basin.
 
 
 
• **Rivers flowing into the Bay of Bengal:**
 
 
• Rivers such as the Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri flow directly into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• These rivers are part of the peninsular river systems and are not connected to the Ganga.
 
 
 
• **Hirakud Dam on the Mahanadi:**
 
 
• The Hirakud Dam, located near Sambalpur in Odisha, is one of the longest earthen dams in the world.
 
• It plays a crucial role in irrigation, flood control, and hydroelectric power generation.
 
 
 
• **Bay of Bengal:**
 
 
• The Bay of Bengal is the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean and serves as the final destination for several major rivers of India.
 
• It supports diverse ecosystems and acts as a vital economic zone for regional countries.
